<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Merfolk Weapon Familiarity](/Feats.aspx?ID=5344) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Merfolk" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=761" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 36

</column>

---

You were taught the most effective weapons of the sea. You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the [merfolk](/Traits.aspx?ID=761) trait. You have familiarity with [crossbows](/Weapons.aspx?ID=425), [heavy crossbows](/Weapons.aspx?ID=428), [longspears](/Weapons.aspx?ID=361), [spears](/Weapons.aspx?ID=365), and [tridents](/Weapons.aspx?ID=401)—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons and any that are advanced weapons as martial weapons.

 At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its [critical specialization effect](/Rules.aspx?ID=235).
name: Merfolk Weapon Familiarity
